title: Burns taking bank deposits for dates Fields did not know about
summary: Burns collects money from military bases for return dates Fields never contracted, and the FBI moves in.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: So Burns was just doing fine and was tickled and all until Burns went to taking money from those army bases and air force bases, and one thing about it, he never would (inaudible), I wouldn't know anything about the contract, and so a lot of it was return dates the second round, so they had had my name in all those places and they would call my wife, call my home, and say where's Ernie Fields, he's supposed to be here tonight. She said no, he's so and so, he's somewhere else. Well, we have a contract that he's supposed to be here and so, (inaudible).
Yeah, I was in the clear.

He just went on and did so many of those, and they turned the FBI on him, and when he found out that, a long time after that, I don't know what in the world happened, but I really wanted to find Burns, because he did a lot. It wasn't as big as some of the other agencies, like William Morris or Jim Artis, but it was so regular.
We worked so regular that sometimes we didn't have time to get laundry done.
